en.bdb: How great is His one vibration which has created the whole expanse of the world!
How big is His weighing hook that it has sustained the whole creation!
Creating crores of universes He has spread around His power of speech.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਗਾਸਿ ਅਧਰ ਧਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: lakh lakh dharat agaas adhar dharaiaa|

en.bdb: Lakhs of earths and skies He kept hanging without support.
Million types of airs, waters and fires He created.
He created the game of eighty four lakhs of species.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਨਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: jon jon jeea ja(n)t a(n)t na paiaa|

en.bdb: No end is known of the creatures of even one species.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੯॥
verses.translit_en: sir sir lekh likhai alekh dhiaaiaa ||9||

en.bdb: He has engraved writ on the forehead of all so that they all meditate upon the Lord who is beyond writ.
